selection_policy: conservative production default below the observed 59k-token Metal OOM boundary, with 4096 tokens reserved for generation

probes.evidence: production request exhausted Metal memory and left the model endpoint insufficient as a health signal

notes: The model architecture declares 262144 positions, but that is not treated as a verified machine capacity.
A 65514-token synthetic prompt completed once, but a production prompt of approximately 59000 tokens caused Metal OOM on this 16 GB Mac.
The 49152-token context window reserves 4096 tokens for output, limiting the prompt budget to 45056 tokens.
Higher values require a production-representative successful benchmark before becoming the default.
